name: Kamen Rider Revice
description: In 1971, a scientific expedition in Latin America had uncovered an ancient artifact containing the remains of the demon Giff, leading to the creation of the Vistamps. In the present day, the remains of Giff now lie in the hands of a demon cult called the Deadmans, who seek to resurrect him by converting peoples' inner demons into their fold. Fenix, a governmental organization opposing the Deadmans, have developed the Revice Driver for someone with complete control over their inner demon. Ikki Igarashi, a young man who runs a public bath with his family, comes into acquisition of the belt while forming a contract with his inner demon Vice. Together, as Kamen Rider Revi and Vice, they are Kamen Rider Revice!

credits_cast.character: Daiji Igarashi / Kamen Rider Live, Kagero / Kamen Rider Evil
credits_cast.name: Wataru Hyuga

credits_cast.character: Aguilera / Hana Natsuki / Kamen Rider Aguilera
credits_cast.name: Hikari Kabashima

videos.title: Family! Contract! The Demon Whispers!
videos.overview: Ikki Igarashi's life turns to the bizarre when he starts seeing a demon who appeared from within his body.

videos.title: The Demon is Just a Bad Guy!?
videos.overview: Ikki refuses to continue using the Revice Driver as he insists on working at his family's sento and is afraid of Vice's desire to eat humans.

videos.title: Hostage Trouble, What To Do Brother!?
videos.overview: As the Igarashis face an eviction notice and the potential loss of their sento due to city renovations, Daiji visits his hospitalized mother, Yukimi, for advice.

videos.title: Not Enough Love! A Dangerous Devil is Born!
videos.overview: Ikki successfully rescues Sakura and Ayaka from a Deadman, only to learn their kidnapper is not in possession of the corresponding Vistamp, forcing him and Vice to find it before it causes more trouble.

videos.title: The World Reforming Rider! Who is the Traitor!?
videos.overview: After Ikki officially joins Fenix, his father Genta takes advantage by establishing a project to garner subscribers.

videos.title: Evil's True Identity! Shocking Showtime!?
videos.overview: In the hopes of identifying the mysterious Kamen Rider Evil, Ikki and his friends develop a strategy involving Bon.

videos.title: Theft!? Skateboard!? I'm Kagero!
videos.overview: While Ikki is dispatched to stop two of four thieves who became Phase 2 Deadmen, Kadota notices Daiji's sudden personality change.

videos.title: Family Rest, Heaven and Hell!?
videos.overview: To celebrate Yukimi being discharged from the hospital, the Igarashis take a trip to a hot spring resort. Upon arriving however, they learn that their regular customers, the Ushijima family, are also there.

videos.title: Runaway Kagero! Igarashi Brothers... Collapse!?
videos.overview: After the Igarashi family discovers what happened to Daiji, Fenix orders Ikki to eliminate Kagero.

videos.title: Older and Younger Brother, the Heart That Believes
videos.overview: Despite learning that Kagero was spawned from Daiji's inferiority complex towards him, Ikki continues to fight in the hopes of reaching his brother.

videos.title: Invincible Sakura, Power for What Purpose
videos.overview: Due to the increasing numbers of Deadmen-related crimes, people who receive Vistamps begin to use them in new ways.

videos.title: Weakness is Strength!? The Invincible Jeanne!1
videos.overview: After Sakura awakens her inner demon instead of becoming a Kamen Rider and Ikki is injured while protecting her, Daiji demands she hand over her Rider equipment to Fenix so they can investigate the person who sent them.

videos.title: Fenix's Close Call!
videos.overview: Fenix is forced to land their mobile headquarters, the Sky Base, in order to refuel, restock on supplies, and give several of their operatives, such as Kadota, time off.

videos.title: The Commander Is... a Deadman!?
videos.overview: Wakabayashi is suspected of being a traitor and the contract holder connected to the Chameleon Deadman. In spite of Daiji and Kadota's shock, Karizaki decides to set a trap for the Deadman to confirm.

videos.title: Eradicate! Showdown! Deadmans!
videos.overview: A shocked Aguilera discovers she is intended to become a sacrifice for Giff's revival instead of his bride, which her right hand Orteca knew about and withheld from her while her bodyguard Julio becomes livid over the revelation.

videos.title: Desire to Protect... The Time of the Three Igarashi Siblings!
videos.overview: Deadmans' attack has been thwarted, but Aguilera and Julio are on the run together while Orteca and the Chameleon Deadman move forward with their own plans.

videos.title: Deepening Betrayal, the True Value of Buddies
videos.overview: Shortly after the Chameleon Deadman's demise and Kadota's promotion to commander, Karizaki discovers the truth behind Genta's condition.

videos.title: Buddy's Trajectory, A Miracle of Fire and Ice
videos.overview: Upon learning Deadmans can use the Giff Stamp to sacrifice humans and turn them into Gifftarian Deadmen, Ikki strengthens his resolve to avert Giff's revival.

videos.title: Demons' Warning, Hiromi's Siege!?
videos.overview: After Kamen Rider Revice successfully masters the Volcano Rex Vistamp's power and develop the ability to separate Gifftex Deadmen from their human hosts while restoring Julio's humanity, Orteca grows worried over the latter prospect and begins to target Kadota.

videos.title: Ruthless and Temporary, The Price of Transformation
videos.overview: After Yamagiri is revealed to be a traitor when she discovered dubious operations within Fenix, Kadota's condition grows worse as he starts hearing his Demons Driver telling him it will devour him.

videos.title: Lay Down My Life, Entrust My Feelings
videos.overview: Ikki and Vice rescue Kadota from the Demons Driver, but he chooses to resign from Fenix due to his fluctuating emotions and wavering loyalty to the organization; Fenix has captured Orteca, who has been separated from his Deadman form.

videos.title: Slam-Bang... Kuuki Kaidan!?
videos.overview: After losing Kadota to Orteca, Ikki buries himself in his sentô work to distance himself from the tragedy.

videos.title: Vice Takes Over... Betrayal After All!?
videos.overview: Following a mishap with the unsanctioned Rolling Vistamp, Ikki and Vice switch corporeal states. Overjoyed by his new state of being, the latter goes rogue to destroy the Vistamp and make the switch permanent.

videos.title: Bring Back Dr. Karizaki! Inverse Operation!
videos.overview: Following Kagero's testimony regarding Fenix and Giff, George decides to investigate them once more while helping Ikki and Vice reverse the Rolling Vistamp's side effects.

videos.title: Revive! Vail!? Memories of the Igarashi Family
videos.overview: Following Genta Igarashi's sudden transformation into Kamen Rider Vail, Igarashi siblings discovers they are Giff's descendants by birth through their father.

videos.title: Showdown! Farewell!? The End of Darkness and Light
videos.overview: Following Genta Igarashi's sudden transformation into Kamen Rider Vail, the Igarashi siblings discover they are Giff's descendants through their father as their inner demons' connection to the original demon grows stronger.

videos.title: Stop It! Tyrant's Rampage and Violent Runaway
videos.overview: Akaishi reveals Julio, Orteca, and Aguilera are test subjects used by Noah, a group of criminal scientists who seek to use Giff's cells to turn humans into demons, and that he has been using Fenix to transform its soldiers into demons.

videos.title: Beyond Fear, Gale and Thunder! Believe In Yourself and Become One!
videos.overview: As Giff's eerie awakening becomes stronger, it causes Vice to go berserk within Ikki's body and keep escaping from Weekend's custody easily.

videos.title: Crank In! Memory of Hiromi!
videos.overview: Sometimes after Vice's rescue and Orteca's demise, George and the Igarashi siblings discover Kadota is alive, albeit suffering from amnesia.

videos.title: Seiyu! Say Me! The Aftermath of Youth
videos.overview: While at his high school soccer club reunion, Ikki reunites with his former coach and mentor Subaru Kimura, who is now a famous voice actor.

videos.title: Illusionary Guidance, Dream Afterwards
videos.overview: After Sakura joined Weekend, she and Tamaki encounter Aguilera as she finally resurfaces after being forsaken by Giff.

videos.title: Lost Whereabouts, Queen's Pride
videos.overview: After Sakura joined Weekend, she and Tamaki encounter Aguilera as she finally resurfaces after being forsaken by Giff. But Aguilera is acting strange as she attacks Sakura.

videos.title: Lovekov's Rebellion!? Sakura's Resolution
videos.overview: As Lovekov suddenly becomes unresponsive to Sakura's commands, the latter must re-learn her missing motivation before freeing Aguilera from her Deadman form.

videos.title: The Demon Is Calling the Demon
videos.overview: After Aguilera joins Weekend and gains Sakura's friendship after her humanity is restored, the Igarashi siblings regroup with their allies to stop Akaishi from increasing Giff's power and save Akemi.

videos.title: Unknown Threat, the Way We Should Go
videos.overview: The Igarashi siblings, George, and Weekend must re-coordinate their plan to save Akemi, who has fallen into darkness, and prevent Akaishi from announcing his plan to bring about a demon apocalypse on Earth.

videos.title: Humanity at the Crossroads, Their Determination
videos.overview: Following Akaishi's announcement and a tragic incident in Fenix, the peace keeping organization is no more.

videos.title: Inevitable Fierce Battle! The Decisive Demon Recapturing Mission!
videos.overview: In response to Giff's full scale invasion of Earth and Fenix's failed demon removal stamps, Weekend publicly reveals themselves to the world and urges civilians to rebel against Akaishi and his lies, despite the risk.

videos.title: Father and Child Weaving Together! The Ultimate Revice!
videos.overview: Shortly after Akaishi murders Akemi, the Karizakis struggle to create a new Vistamp to counter the revived Giff until Genta confronts his children before allowing himself to be used in the creation of the Giffard Rex Vistamp for Revice.

videos.title: Hope and Despair, the Conflict Between Three Siblings
videos.overview: With Genta surviving a cell transfusion surgery, the Karizakis create the Giffard Rex Vistamp, which Ikki and Vice use to become Kamen Rider Ultimate Revice and give humanity hope and inspire citizens to either join Weekend in fighting Giff's tyranny or build shelters across the city. Furious, Akaishi begins his plot to invade Weekend's base.

videos.title: Family or the World... Brothers Quarrel of the Soul!
videos.overview: Because of Daiji's stubbornness went to the path of devil, Weekend marked him as an enemy in retaliation for betraying his own allies and families who opposes the demon.

videos.title: Father's True Intention, Son's Determination!
videos.overview: After learning of Kagero's death and its negative effect on Daiji's emotions and judgment, Genta intends to settle his conflict with Vail on his own.

videos.title: Fierce Battle! Crimson Vail and Destream
videos.overview: After receiving a modified Vail Driver from George, Genta intends to settle the score with a weakened Vail by transforming into Kamen Rider Destream and facing the demon in combat.

videos.title: The End of Eternity, Where Regret Leads
videos.overview: While Genta and Vail reconcile with each other following their battle, and Daiji were about to rejoin his family at the same time, Giff revives Akaishi as a Gigademos.

videos.title: Lay Down My Body and Soul, The Whereabouts of the Decision
videos.overview: While Hikaru successfully defeats Akaishi and avenges Kimiko and Tasuke, he is unable to kill him due to the Over Demons system taking a heavy toll on him.

videos.title: Never-Ending Nightmare, Protectors and the Protected
videos.overview: With Hiromi's help, Daiji sees the error of his ways and revives Kagero, restoring his spiritual balance and returning to his family's side.

videos.title: Courage to Face Each Other... What Should You Really Protect?
videos.overview: While Vice mentally struggles against Giff, the heroes learn that defeating Giff's demons and freeing the previous victims who were used for the demon's revival spreads his parasites at a faster rate.

videos.title: Karizaki's Rebellion, The Price of Transformation
videos.overview: With Giff finally defeated properly, the Igarashis and their allies intend to have a peaceful day while Fenix reforms under new management.

videos.title: Proof of Determination! This is... Japan's No. 1 Busybody!
videos.overview: After barely escaping from Juuga, the Igarashi siblings learns from Hiromi the truth that he discovered behind the recently fallen scientist's rampage.

videos.title: At the End of the Battle... Only the Demon Remains
videos.overview: After George is freed from Chic's control, Ikki has forgotten all memories of his family and goes to pursue a normal life. However, a corrupted Vice arises as a new threat.

videos.title: Family to the End, Until the Day We Meet Again
videos.overview: What seemed to be Vice betraying Ikki, turns out to be his way of attempting to restore Ikki's memories. However, the restoration of Ikki's memories would mean voiding the contract between the two.
